event80.quote: Reaching the Pre-Specified 80th Event Triggers the Final Analysis of the Pivotal Phase 3 Trial

topline.quote: REGAL trial met its primary endpoint with GPS demonstrating statistically significant and clinically meaningful reduction in risk of death by 41% with median overall survival of 24.0 months versus 14.7 months for best available treatment, and a hazard ratio of 0.59 (p=0.035)

since.text: After the close, SELLAS announced a proposed $150.0 million underwritten public offering of common stock
